contexts.text: Would become worse than savage beasts.
Then their latter state would become worse than the first. Explained. AC 8159:end.
It is a law in the other life that no one is allowed to become worse than he was in the world. Explained. SE 3093.
They who are such (here) become worse in the other life.
They think they will fare no worse (hereafter) than others.
That the internal nature of man begins to become worse more and more. Explained.
The leading and bending of evil, which continually tends to worse and worst. Explained.
In the other life (such) suppose that they are contracting a worse life... Thus it is not acquiring a worse life. Explained.
The whole World of Spirits becomes worse and worse. (See World of Spirits.)
(By these grievous punishments) they were not made better, but worse. SE 4511.
